item.title: Cirencester Vegan Market – March 2026
item.description: Join Vegan Fairs for a day jam-packed with all things plant-based and cruelty-free. You can expect to see a wide range of vegan stalls including delicious vegan street food, baked goods and sweet treats, ethical clothing brands, cruelty free cosmetics, arts and crafts, charities and outreach as well as free samples from our info tent.

item.title: Chepstow Vegan Market - April
item.description: Taking place on The High Street right in the town centre, Chepstow Vegan Market will showcase the best vegan products from both local and national independent vegan businesses. You can expect incredible street food through to indulgent homemade bakes and cakes. We’ll also have a number of non-food items on offer such as ethical fashion brands, cruelty-free skincare, eco-friendly homeware items and much more. You don’t need to be a vegan to enjoy this market and everyone is welcome.

item.title: Taunton Vegan Market 2026
item.description: The Vegan Fairs team are returning to Taunton in 2026! We’ll be bringing our vegan market back to the beautiful Goodland Gardens, with plenty of grassy areas for you to sit, socialise and fill your belly with delicious vegan food! We will be showcasing the very best independent vegan businesses and brands. Expect everything from street food to sweet treats and bakes, vegan cheese to ethical fashion brands, zero waste household to cruelty-free skincare and more!

item.title: Norwich Summer Vegan Fair ( hosted by Action for Greyhounds)
item.description: Join Action for Greyhounds for their Norwich Vegan Summer Fair. There will be a variety of vegan stalls, food and drink, hand crafted gifts, beauty products, animal charities and animal rights campaigns. Promoting a cruelty free lifestyle and Veganism, for the animals, for the planet, for better health

item.title: Exmouth Vegan Market 2026
item.description: New for 2026! This Summer we will be bringing a vegan market to the Sideshore on Exmouth beach for the first time! Browse a range of products from local and national independent businesses including incredible street food, sweet bakes and treats, deli items like vegan cheese, arts and crafts, charities and outreach and much more. This event isn’t just for vegans. We guarantee everyone will find something they enjoy!
